//: Model manifest for the local song service. install.py reads this file: it pip-installs each entry in 'packages' (a package manager, not a manual clone) and then fetches the weights named by 'repo' into 'target'. Nothing here runs in the browser or on Cloudflare.

cuda.note: No CUDA toolkit install is needed on Windows: the NVIDIA driver provides the runtime, and the torch wheel at this index carries its own CUDA libraries. PyPI's default 'torch' on Windows is CPU-only, which is why the index is declared per package instead of left to defaults.

note: A 3.5B text-to-music model with sung lyrics. On 8 GB of VRAM it runs with cpu_offload (ACE_CPU_OFFLOAD=1), which trades speed for fitting in memory.
